data.description: 【陈 · 军校剑术课】维多利亚皇家近卫学院的旧击剑馆，晨光斜照木地板。学员时代的陈身着藏青礼服制服，手持细剑摆出标准刺击姿势，动作干净利落——「剑术的第一课不是出剑，是收剑。风笛，再来一次。」

data.promptProse: In the old fencing hall of the Victoria Royal Guard Academy, morning light slants across the worn wooden floor. Cadet Chen stands in her deep navy double-breasted dress uniform with gold trim, holding a slender rapier in a standard thrust-ready stance, each movement crisp and precise as she drills the first lesson of the sheathed sword. A lone figure on the sunlit boards, a partner's name carried faintly on the air.
